assertion_audit.regression_and_failure: Deleting the retirement FOREACH or the outer eligibility guard leaves the name at exhausted, the source at composed and names_retired at 0; all four reads are independent graph queries or the function's own return, and negative_control_retirement_removed.log records this exact removal reddening three cases.

A receipt with another operation or origin breaks equality with the literal pair, and reverting to a CREATE per recycled source makes the second pass report 1 and the count 2; focused-before-commit.log records that regression failing 1 failed / 55 passed.
Removing the new NOT EXISTS live-source filter lets the source return to extracted; negative_control_live_source_taken.log shows the contested case failing on precisely that assertion.
Refusing to release a superseded target's source, or retiring it again, reddens the extracted-status and names_retired assertions.
Retiring a name that still has a live producer source, or deleting the retained producer's edge, reddens the kept-source status or the name_stage assertion.
Reinstating the supplied patch's per-source retirement produces two receipts and fails the count == 1 assertion.
Counting a stale producer as live leaves name_stage at exhausted and names_retired at 0; the stale status read at :227 is independent of the code under test.

Retiring a derived or catalog exhausted name, or releasing its source, reddens the composed-status and not-sourceless assertions; the protection properties are set in the fixture and read back from the graph.

findings: FINDING tests/standard_names/test_recycled_source_retires_name.py:109 non-blocking: the protected-stage parameter list passes 'refined', which is not a NameStage value (imas_codex/graph/models.py:1405 defines 'refining'), and the 'refining' case the recorded base reproduction exercised is absent from the committed file, so the live refine-claim stage is not among the cases guarding the new live-source filter.

FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_audits.py:1107 non-blocking: names_retired is computed and returned, but the only production caller (imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:1936) logs only live_realigned and orphaned_reset, so a retirement stays invisible in the pool log beyond the generic 'returned to extracted' line.

limitations: The two whole-directory arms deselect the graph marker (541 and 553 deselected), so the new test file is covered only by the focused 57-case arm and the two mutation arms.

The 13 pre-existing sourceless exhausted names were not retired; the live ten-name endpoint remains unmet and the signed-path repair in imas_codex/standard_names/graph_supersession.py is outside this landing's grants.
This review reran no test and modified no source; it reads the recorded logs and git.
